svg.title: StreetWorld framework
svg.desc: The Scene Manager initializes simulation environments from GS assets, traffic data, HD maps and collision models, with initialization and editing functions. Actor and Participants each contain a Policy, Controller and Observer. Policies send actions to controllers, controllers update the environment, and observers return signals to policies. The Environment updates the scene and evaluates it. The Env Interface provides Remote and Local access, with bidirectional connections to the simulation and AD policies including Expert, Keyboard, UniAD and VLA.
